statements.statement: Calling lcd.clear() in every loop iteration on a character LCD is a good practice for updating live data.
statements.explanation: Calling lcd.clear() each iteration causes a visible blink/flicker. Instead, overwrite old text in place or use fixed-width formatting.

statements.statement: OLED displays using a framebuffer approach don't flicker during redraws because the entire frame is composed off-screen before being sent.
statements.explanation: With a framebuffer, the full frame is drawn in memory first, then pushed to the display at once, avoiding the flicker that comes from clearing and redrawing on screen.

statements.statement: A temperature display should update every 100ms to keep the reading accurate.
statements.explanation: Temperature changes slowly, so updating every 2-5 seconds is fine. Very fast update intervals (100ms) are better suited for rapidly changing values like a dial position.
